name: Dijon-Roasted Sockeye Salmon with Asparagus & Bacon Lentils

instructions.primary_message: Pat salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a baking sheet pan. Season with spices, then spread with Dijon and drizzle with oil. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg sockeye salmon fillet
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper
1 ½ tbsp Dijon mustard
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and snap (or cut) off woody ends of the asparagus. Place on a large baking sheet; season with salt and pepper, then drizzle with additional oil. Toss to coat, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 small bunches asparagus
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
1 ½ tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing asparagus halfway through, until salmon easily flakes with a fork and asparagus is tender, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add bacon and cook, stirring occasionally, until crispy, 5-6 minutes.
When the bacon is done, add lentils to the pot along with vinegar and spices. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until the lentils are warmed through, 2-3 minutes more. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
1 ½ tsp garlic powder
1 ½ tsp onion powder
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide lentils, asparagus, and salmon between plates. Enjoy!
